name: Texas Sheet Cake
subtitle: Levi’s favorite
notes: Who are we kidding, a much smaller crowd could clean one of these up in no time. Walnuts were definitely not approved by Levi, but they are yummy anyway.

steps.title: Melt the butter
steps.body: Melt in a saucepan and whisk: **1 cup butter**, **1 cup water** and **5 Tbsp cocoa powder**.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Combine and mix in with whisk: **2 cups flour**, **2 cups white sugar**, **1 tsp baking soda** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Add eggs and sour cream
steps.body: Mix in with whisk: **2 eggs** and **½ cup sour cream**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes in a greased 10×15 pan.

steps.title: Frost
steps.body: Frost while still warm with this frosting: **6 Tbsp milk**, **5 Tbsp cocoa powder**, **½ cup butter**, **4 cups powdered sugar**, **1 tsp vanilla** and **1 cup chopped walnuts**.
